summary: California BanCorp filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing that its board authorized an increase of 1,600,000 shares to its existing share repurchase program, lifting total authorization to 3,200,000 shares from the prior 1,600,000. The program, originally approved June 14, 2023 and last amended May 1, 2025, has no expiration date and may be executed in open-market or privately negotiated transactions, funded from working capital and operating cash flow, including potential Rule 10b5-1 plans. No price, premium, or advisor was stated; watch repurchase pace and capital ratios.
